snippet.textDisplay:
It's very funny to me how the tone is changing from everyone loving this game to everyone nitpicking and I kind of knew that would happen because it always happens when everyone waits so long for something... People lose the plot and they stop understanding nuance and they don't understand game development at all, and I don't really think they understand streaming or youtubing or social media either which is really weird because it's now been around for a really long time. 

If I had to change something about this game, personally I'd love if it wasn't in the US. I don't like it here, it's ugly here. The buildings are all new and there's nothing to it. Other parts of the world have history. Like hundreds or thousands of years of history. 

Yeah the Florida keys looks beautiful here, no doubt. But why can't we steal cars in the Alps or downtown Moscow or Rome or something??? You know what I mean?

That being said, the lighting is beautiful. The people suck in personality but I love how unique everyone is. Everything has so much character. The world feels REAL.
